question: Is IHOP Open on Christmas Day?
quick_answer: Yes, most IHOP restaurants are open on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day, which falls on a Friday in 2026. IHOP does not close nationwide for the holiday, but each restaurant sets its own hours, so some open later, close early or stay closed. Check your local IHOP's hours on its website or app, or call ahead, before you go.
key_facts: Most IHOPs are open on Christmas Eve and Christmas Day

body.heading: IHOP is usually open on Christmas
body.text: IHOP is one of the few big sit-down chains that stays open on Christmas. In recent years, IHOP has said its restaurants would be open on the holiday with hours that may vary by location, and holiday round-ups from news outlets list it as open on both Christmas Eve and Christmas Day. That makes it a common pick for travelers, people working the holiday and families who want breakfast without the dishes.

body.heading: Why hours vary by location
body.text: Most IHOP restaurants are run by franchise owners, and each one decides its own holiday hours. Some 24-hour locations stay open through Christmas, while others run shorter hours. One past holiday list showed some IHOPs open from early morning to mid-afternoon on Christmas Day, so do not assume your usual hours apply.

body.heading: Christmas Eve hours
body.text: IHOP restaurants are generally open on Christmas Eve too, but some may close earlier than normal. If you plan a late dinner on December 24, check your restaurant's hours first.

body.heading: How to check your local IHOP
body.text: Use the restaurant finder on IHOP's website or app and open your location's page, which shows holiday hours when the restaurant updates them. The safest option is to call the restaurant a day or two before Christmas.

body.heading: Other places open on Christmas
body.text: If your IHOP is closed or the wait is long, Denny's and Waffle House are the other big breakfast chains that usually open on Christmas Day. Cracker Barrel, by contrast, closes its restaurants on Christmas Day.

faqs.q: Is IHOP open on Christmas Day 2026?
faqs.a: Most IHOP restaurants are expected to be open on Friday, December 25, 2026, but hours vary by location. Check your local IHOP before you go.
